<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/insurant-recourse">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Request for payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CollectionCase" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Recourse" name="Recourse process" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CollectionAgency" name="Collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" name="Request for payment" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CollectionCase" name="Case forwarded" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency" messageRef="Message_CollectionCase"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle recourse case" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Information" name="Information about possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?" default="Flow_NotPossible">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Possible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send request for payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Possible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for case outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Money received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Book_Close</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Disagreement received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disagreement_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disagreement_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reasoning_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningValid" name="Is the insurant right?" default="Flow_InsurantWrong">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reasoning_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeadlineReached" name="Disagreement deadline reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_Forward</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Deadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward case to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_Forward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseClosed" name="Case closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Book_Close</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantRight</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Forwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_Information" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Possible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>The possibility of recourse is confirmed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPossible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="End_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Book" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Book_Close" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="End_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_Check" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reasoning_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantRight" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid" targetRef="End_CaseClosed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>The insurant is right</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantWrong" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_Forward" sourceRef="Event_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Forward_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="End_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/insurant-recourse">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Money received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle recourse case" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Information" name="Information about possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?" default="Flow_NotPossible">

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Money received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Book_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Disagreement with recourse received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disagreement_Check</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check the insurant's reasoning">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantRight</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Book" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Book_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_Check" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reasoning_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantRight" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/insurant-recourse">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Actor" name="I" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle recourse case" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Recourse">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Actor" name="I">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Information</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecoursePossible</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MakeReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_PaymentReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MakeBooking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DisagreementReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckReasoning</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReasoningValid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DeadlineReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ForwardCase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClosureMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CloseCase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CaseClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Forwarded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Information" name="Information about possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check the case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?" default="Flow_NotPossible">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Possible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send request for payment to the insurant">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Possible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make a reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for payment, disagreement, or deadline">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Money received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make a booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Book_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disagreement_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check the insurant's reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disagreement_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reasoning_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningValid" name="Is the insurant right?" default="Flow_InsurantWrong">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reasoning_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeadlineReached" name="Disagreement deadline reached with no money received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_Forward</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Deadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward the case to a collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_Forward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClosureMerge" name="Continue to close the case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Book_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseCase</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseCase" name="Close the case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseCase</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseClosed" name="Case closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Forwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_Information" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Possible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recoursePossible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPossible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Book" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Book_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_Check" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reasoning_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantRight" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insurantIsRight</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantWrong" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_Forward" sourceRef="Event_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseCase" sourceRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge" targetRef="Task_CloseCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Close_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseCase" targetRef="End_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Forward_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="End_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/insurant-recourse">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SubrogationInformation" name="Information about possible subrogation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Request for payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MoneyReceived" name="Money received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ForwardedCase" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle recourse case" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Information" name="Information about possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SubrogationInformation" messageRef="Message_SubrogationInformation"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?" default="Flow_NotPossible">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Possible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send request for payment to the insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Possible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make a reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for payment, disagreement, or deadline">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reminder_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Money received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Payment" messageRef="Message_MoneyReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make a booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Book</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Book_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Disagreement with recourse received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disagreement_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check the insurant's reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disagreement_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reasoning_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningValid" name="Is the insurant right?" default="Flow_InsurantWrong">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reasoning_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeadlineReached" name="Deadline reached without receiving money">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_Forward</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Deadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward the case to the collection agency" messageRef="Message_ForwardedCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_Forward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClosureMerge" name="Continue to close the case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Book_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseCase</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseCase" name="Close the case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseCase</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseClosed" name="Case closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Close_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Forwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Forward_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_Information" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Possible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Recourse is possible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPossible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Book" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Book_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_Check" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reasoning_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantRight" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid" targetRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The insurant is right</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantWrong" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningValid" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_Forward" sourceRef="Event_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseCase" sourceRef="Gateway_ClosureMerge" targetRef="Task_CloseCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Close_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseCase" targetRef="End_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Forward_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="End_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Actor" name="Case handler" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that a matter is brought to completion after a decision or another activity: Model the stated completion work as an activity on the applicable path before the process outcome.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states that a matter is brought to completion after a decision or another activity

rules.instruction: When the description states the action, purpose, recipient, scope, or outcome of a process element: Label the corresponding BPMN element with a concise phrase that preserves those stated semantics; do not substitute a related but different meaning, omit distinguishing details, or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description states the action, decision, or event trigger of a process element

rules.instruction: When the description mentions an external person or organization only as the recipient or source of a communication, without describing that party performing process activities or a separate process: Model the stated communication and any resulting wait or receipt within the described process; do not add a separate participant pool or message flows for that party.
rules.situation: the description mentions an external person or organization only as the recipient or source of a communication, without describing that party performing process activities or a separate process

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that an activity follows the process start or another activity: connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows in the stated order, preserving any intervening gateways and branches
rules.situation: the description states that an activity, start, or decision outcome is followed by another activity or a process outcome

rules.instruction: When the description narrates work performed by a first-person actor and states that the actor communicates with people or organizations outside that work: Model the narrated actor as a participant pool in the collaboration, with the actor’s described work in its process.
rules.situation: the description narrates work performed by a first-person actor and states that the actor communicates with people or organizations outside that work

rules.instruction: When the description states that an actor performs a concrete action on a decision outcome or after another activity: Model the stated work as an activity on the applicable path. Use gateways to route or synchronize flow, not as substitutes for the work.
rules.situation: the description states that an actor performs a concrete action on a decision outcome or after another activity
